{{Short description|Italian-American physicist}}
'''Lorenzo M. Narducci''' (25 May 1942 – 21 July 2006) was an Italian-American physicist known for his contributions to [[quantum optics]] and the study of laser instabilities, in particular. He was the author of more than 200 scientific papers and several books including ''Laser Physics and Laser Instabilities''.<ref name=LPI>{{cite book | last1=Narducci | first1=L. M. | last2=Abraham | first2=N.B. | title=Laser Physics and Laser Instabilities | publisher=World Scientific | year=1988 | isbn=978-9971-5-0062-7 | doi=10.1142/0234 | bibcode=1988lpli.book.....N }}</ref>  In addition to his research on the theory of laser instabilities<ref name=LPI /><ref>{{cite journal | last1=Bonifacio | first1=R. | last2=Pellegrini | first2=C. | last3=Narducci | first3=L.M. | title=Collective instabilities and high-gain regime in a free electron laser | journal=Optics Communications | publisher=Elsevier BV | volume=50 | issue=6 | year=1984 | issn=0030-4018 | doi=10.1016/0030-4018(84)90105-6 | pages=373–378| bibcode=1984OptCo..50..373B | s2cid=51853817 | url=https://digital.library.unt.edu/ark:/67531/metadc1071383/ }}</ref> he also contributed to the physics of emission and absorption in three-level systems,<ref>{{cite journal | last1=Narducci | first1=L. M. | last2=Scully | first2=M. O. |author-link2=Marlan Scully| last3=Oppo | first3=G.-L. | last4=Ru | first4=P. | last5=Tredicce | first5=J. R. | title=Spontaneous emission and absorption properties of a driven three-level system | journal=Physical Review A | publisher=American Physical Society (APS) | volume=42 | issue=3 | date=1990-08-01 | issn=1050-2947 | doi=10.1103/physreva.42.1630 | pages=1630–1649| pmid=9904196 | bibcode=1990PhRvA..42.1630N | url=https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/80692/1/Narducci_etal_PRA_1990_Spontaneous_emission_and_absorption_properties_of_a_driven_three_level_system.pdf }}</ref> and frequency locking.<ref>{{cite journal | last1=Lugiato | first1=L. A. | last2=Narducci | first2=L. M. | last3=Oldano | first3=C. | title=Cooperative frequency locking and stationary spatial structures in lasers | journal=Journal of the Optical Society of America B | publisher=The Optical Society | volume=5 | issue=5 | date=1988-05-01 | issn=0740-3224 | doi=10.1364/josab.5.000879 | pages=879–888| bibcode=1988JOSAB...5..879L }}</ref>

Narducci received his PhD from the [[University of Milan]] for research on optical [[coherence (physics)|coherence]] in [[quantum electrodynamics]].  He served as editor of [[Optics Communications]] (1987-2006) and was member of the editorial board at [[Physical Review A]].

Narducci was a [[OSA Fellow|Fellow of the Optical Society]] and among various awards, he received the 1991 ''[[Einstein Prize for Laser Science]]'' and the 1999  ''Willis E. Lamb Award for Laser Science and Quantum Optics''.
